theoremCandidate.formFactors: In the scalar quartic sector, O_H=phi^2/2 reaches four on-shell scalars at order lambda through one propagator, while the beta_lambda O_4 trace term reaches them through a local contact form factor.
theoremCandidate.mixedRatio: Up to common convention factors, r_4=2m^2+beta_lambda/[lambda sum_i((q-p_i)^2-m^2)^-1], so nonzero beta_lambda gives a finite ratio distinct from the scalar-pair value at generic kinematics.
theoremCandidate.kinematicVariation: The propagator sum changes across four-body phase space, so r_4 is not a fixed relabelling of the scalar-pair ray.
theoremCandidate.thresholdSeparation: Gauge-pair, scalar-pair and four-scalar cuts start at distinct thresholds 0,4m^2,16m^2 in the massless-gauge simplified rung, making their leading weights spectrally identifiable.
theoremCandidate.fullSpan: The gauge-only point at infinity, scalar-pair ratio 2m^2 and any generic four-scalar ratio have nonzero projective coordinate determinant and therefore span H2(R).
theoremCandidate.schemeCovariance: O_g -> O_g+c O_H shifts every finite ratio by c and leaves the determinant with the infinity direction unchanged.
